reply_text:
It is partly "we need more HEADs", and I counted it: of the 199 mission targets that have a file, 15 have a HEAD with content.

**The count, from the current mission registry:**

| Mission targets with a file | 199 |
|---|---:|
| HEAD section with content | 15 |
| HEAD section holding only the template definition | 1 |
| No HEAD section, opening of 200 characters or more | 140 |
| No HEAD section, opening under 200 characters | 43 |

The 15 real HEADs run from about 430 to 7,000 characters.

**Something I should have flagged earlier.** When a mission has no HEAD, the request script reads whatever comes before the first section. Four of the seven lab readings were made that way, including two of the examples in the post, M-essays-diachronic-model and M-self-documenting-stack. Those openings are usually a title, a status line and some framing, and I have not checked who wrote them. M-distributed-proofreaders, the example you liked, is one of the three read from a real HEAD.

So the data gap has two layers:

- **HEADs:** 184 mission targets lack one.
- **Readings:** even with a HEAD, each target needs one 象 analysis. That is the seat time I have been asking about, and it is separate.

**On your two options, I would combine them.**

- **Agent drafts, marked as such.** An agent writes a HEAD for each open mission from its file, and the section records that it is agent-drafted. The machine then carries HEAD provenance (operator or agent-drafted) as something it counts and reports, so an agent's summary is never mistaken for your statement.
- **You answer where the file cannot.** For the 43 with almost no opening, and any where the draft is wrong, you answer "what is this mission about" and that replaces the draft as an operator HEAD.

The fallback to the file's opening would then go: no HEAD means no reading, counted.

**One practical constraint.** Rewriting 184 mission files in bulk flooded the evidence store on 30 September, so the edits would go in small throttled batches.

**Questions for you:**

- Do I go ahead with agent-drafted HEADs for the 184, throttled, with provenance marked? I would start with ten and show you those before doing the rest.
- Does the same go cover the 象 readings that follow?

The 88 tickets and proposals are a separate case. They are read from their own item text, not from a HEAD.
